name: Revive Adserver
description: Provides plugins for displaying Revive Adserver ads in Drupal.
project_description: Revive Adserver integrates a self-hosted Revive Adserver (formerly OpenX) instance into Drupal. It renders a Revive ad zone's invocation tag either as a placeable block (Revive Adserver Zone Block) or as a field on any fieldable entity (Revive Adserver Zone field type, widget and formatter). Three delivery methods are provided as swappable InvocationMethodService plugins: asynchronous JavaScript, iframe, and (legacy) JavaScript document.write. The delivery URL, publisher id and the list of available zones are held in the revive_adserver.settings config object; zones can be synced from the Revive instance over its XML-RPC API from the settings form (credentials are used transiently and never stored). The invocation method can optionally be chosen per entity by content editors, and the selectable zones and methods can be whitelisted per field.
